title: 第1章 荷洛威的王利第2章 坚持不懈的锻炼
content_zh:
第001章 荷洛威的王利
段松是虚竹子的关门弟子。
也许段松这个名字很普通，但为什么，他却能成为这一代逍遥派掌门人、灵柩宫宫主虚竹子的关门弟子呢？
原因很简单，因为他有很不错的家事，他的老爹便是鼎鼎大名的、和虚竹子有八拜之交的大理段氏最杰出的传人－－段誉。
恩，没错，段松便是段誉的儿子。其实，他还有一个不为人知是事儿：他是一个现代社会的穿越者，却没想到随便跑进一个位面，却到了金庸大大笔下的天龙世界！不过，既来之、则安之，因为有这层关系在，段松从小便和父亲说要去天山学武，他一直仰慕逍遥派的武功，轻灵、飘逸、潇洒，绝对是泡妞必备...
于是他便被父亲送往天山，成了虚竹子的关门弟子。而虚竹子以及天山的长老们也很用心的指导他，在他十九岁那年，小无相功便达到小成境界，一套天山六阳掌更是练的出神入化、无人能敌！
这天，他终于出师了，师傅已经同意让他独自下山闯荡江湖，于是心情不错的他，站在山崖边欣赏着天山的雪景，一边想着以后混迹江湖，英雄救美、美人以身相许、洞房花烛...
天上突然一道闪电瞬间便劈在他的头上，他还没反应过来便全身焦黑、满身僵直的向后倒去，头脑中乱七八糟的想法也随之停顿了...
只见在他的身体正上方出现了一个黝黑的裂缝，一团虚状的物体挣扎着从躺在地上的身体中被吸出，径直进入那条裂缝，随即裂缝便消失在茫茫雪山之中。
......
阴曹地府中，长着一个大大的牛头的人型生物正在对阎王汇报情况：“英明神武的阎罗王大人，刚才我已经动用法术，将那名时空偷渡者抓了回来，现在要怎么处理？”
坐在主位的是一个满脸狰狞的大汉，听了之后，他马上暴躁的吼道：“你个笨牛，还处理、处理个屁啊！那个小鬼刚才又跑了，从12098号裂缝钻了进去，那可是科技界面的时空裂缝，不归咱管，这可怎么办啊~！你竟然让一个小鬼连续跑了两次，真是没有的东西，罚你一个元会的薪水！”
长着牛头的人型生物脸色立刻苦了下来，郁闷的哼哼道：“哎，这只讨厌的小鬼，以后再来地府我直接把你打进十八层地狱！”
......
王利，一个中国人和英格兰人的混血儿，英文名是Alan（艾伦）。他从小就在伦敦的荷洛威地区生活，今年已经十六岁了。
他十分喜欢足球运动，在父母的支持下，年仅八岁的时候，他就进入了阿森纳足球学校的小班就读。在每天的训练中，他一直快乐的生活着，但是，人生的道路不可能一帆风顺的，他遭遇了第一个挫折：没有入选阿森纳青年队。
这也就意味着他无法进入阿森纳队，为阿森纳队的荣耀而战斗。
对此，他感觉很失落。在荷洛威地区成长的孩子都有一个愿望，那就是进入阿森纳队，成为阿森纳的一名球员，为阿森纳队的荣誉而去战斗！但是现在这个愿望显然就要破灭了。
但他却相信自己的实力，他一直是足球学校中有名的锋线小杀手。但是最终和他一起训练的朋友们，很多都被阿森纳青年队选走了，他们中有的是后卫，有的是边锋，甚至是守门员，都远远没有自己有名气。对此他很不服气，难道前锋要受歧视吗？
实际上，阿森纳目前无论是青年队、一线队对前锋的需求都不是很高。

在英格兰，足球已经成为人们生活中的一部分，优秀的前锋比比皆是，而相对来说后卫、中场球员就很少。
而且阿森纳队现在的优秀前锋实在太多了，所以即使王利的水平并不差，在足球学校选人时，阿森纳青年队的斯蒂夫－伯尔德先生还是放弃了他。
不过，王利并没有因此而颓废，他想要去其他球队，用自己的实力来证明阿森纳青年队教练的错误，然后再英雄般的转回阿森纳。
于是，王利便开始了试训之旅。他分别去了富勒姆、西联汉姆、查尔顿，但结果都不尽如人意，他的实力虽然也不差，但那种张口闭口阿森纳的说话语气显然不被这些球队所喜爱，所以…
从小没有遭遇过什么挫折的王利有些退缩了，他很伤心、很绝望。他并不知道这些球队为什么放弃他，他只是觉得自己的足球水平很差，使得那些教练都看不上，于是他觉得从小到大的愿望破灭了，生命已经不重要了，他吃下了大量安眠药...
......
段松睁开了双眼，映入眼帘的是一间西式的客房，他茫然的眨了眨眼，有些吃惊的道：“这难道是现代社会？”
疑惑的看了看，刚想要站起身来，头脑却被一股信息洪流所冲击，骤然疼痛起来，于是他又昏迷了过去。
一天之后，他再次醒来。
睁开双眼，舒展眉宇的笑了笑，自言自语道：“叫王利吗...原来真的是现代社会，2003年8月？这里是伦敦荷洛威地区？这付身体的主人还真是想不开啊。”
王利的父亲王海是伦敦大学的一名年轻的教授，母亲是一名叫埃里斯－蒂娜的英格兰人，这种宽裕的家庭成长起来的孩子心里承受能力并不强，所以遭遇了一点点挫折便选择轻生。
这恰恰便宜了段松。
“既然占据了你的身体，就帮你实现梦想吧，做一名出色的足球运动员吗？不过，我可并不喜欢阿森纳队，他们既然放弃了我，那么确实应该让他们后悔！我虽然不擅长踢足球，而且这具身体也没有任何的内力，但是在灵柩宫练习了那么多年的武功，在修炼一些内力，踢足球还是很容易的吧。”他有些开心的想到。
那么，以后白天练习足球，晚上修炼内力，这里可是现代社会，并不在阎罗王的辖区，他们应该抓不到自己了吧。
他从沙发上站起来，伸了伸腰，摸了摸肚子。
只听“咕、咕”的响声从肚子中传来，他裂了裂嘴，原来自己已经昏迷很长时间了，看来需要去吃点东西了。
他转着仔细的找了一遍，在冰箱里找到一些罐头、泡面，便马上囫囵吞枣的吃掉了。
摸了摸有些凸起的胃部，满意的笑了笑，拿上床边的一个印有‘NIKE’的足球，向楼下走去。
在“王利”的记忆中，这栋楼后面有个小足球场，平时他也经常在那里独自练球。
content_en:
Chapter 001 Holloway’s Wang Li
Duan Song is a close disciple of Xu Zhuzi.
Maybe the name Duan Song is very common, but why can he become the closed disciple of Xu Zhuzi, the leader of this generation of Xiaoyao Sect and the master of the Coffin Palace?
The reason is very simple, because he has a very good family background. His father is the most outstanding descendant of the famous Duan family in Dali, Duan Yu, who has been friends with Xu Zhuzi for eight years.
Well, that's right, Duan Song is Duan Yu's son. In fact, there is another unknown thing about him: he is a time traveler in modern society, but he didn't expect to randomly run into a plane and end up in the world of Tianlong written by Jin Yong! However, once you get there, make peace with it. Because of this relationship, Duan Song has told his father since he was a child that he would go to Tianshan to learn martial arts. He has always admired the Xiaoyao sect's martial arts. It is light, elegant and unrestrained. It is definitely a must-have for picking up girls...
So he was sent to Tianshan by his father and became Xu Zhuzi's closed disciple. And Xu Zhuzi and the elders of Tianshan also carefully guided him. When he was nineteen years old, Xiao Wuxiang Gong reached the level of Xiaocheng, and he practiced a set of Tianshan Six Yang Palm to such a superb level that no one could beat him!
On this day, he finally started his apprenticeship. The master had agreed to let him go down the mountain alone to explore the world. So he was in a good mood. He stood on the edge of the cliff and admired the snow scenery of Tianshan Mountain.
Suddenly a bolt of lightning struck his head in an instant. Before he could react, his whole body was blackened and stiff, and he fell backwards. The messy thoughts in his mind also stopped...
A dark crack appeared directly above his body. A group of virtual objects struggled to be sucked out of the body lying on the ground, and went straight into the crack. Then the crack disappeared into the vast snow-capped mountains.
...
In the underworld, a humanoid creature with a big bull's head is reporting the situation to the King of Hell: "Wise and mighty Lord Yama, I just used magic to capture the time and space stowaway. What should I do now?"
The person sitting in the main seat was a big man with a ferocious face. After hearing this, he immediately yelled angrily: "You stupid cow, you still have to deal with it! That kid ran away again just now and got in through the crack No. 12098. That is a space-time crack in the technology interface, which is not under our control. What can we do~! You actually let a kid run away twice in a row. You are really worthless. I will fine you a Yuanhui salary!"
The face of the bull-headed humanoid creature immediately turned bitter, and he groaned depressedly: "Hey, this annoying little devil, if you come to the underworld in the future, I will send you directly to the eighteenth level of hell!"
...
Wang Li, a mixed-race Chinese and Englishman, whose English name is Alan. He has lived in the Holloway area of ​​London since he was a child and is now sixteen years old.
He likes football very much. With the support of his parents, he entered the small class of Arsenal Football School when he was only eight years old. In daily training, he has been living happily. However, the road in life cannot be smooth sailing. He encountered his first setback: he was not selected for the Arsenal youth team.
This also means that he cannot enter the Arsenal team and fight for the glory of Arsenal.
He felt very lost about this. Children who grow up in the Holloway area all have one wish, and that is to join the Arsenal team, become an Arsenal player, and fight for the honor of the Arsenal team! But now this wish is obviously going to be dashed.
But he believes in his own strength. He has always been a famous striker in the football school. But in the end, many of his friends who trained with him were selected by the Arsenal youth team. Some of them were defenders, some were wingers, and even goalkeepers, and they were far less famous than himself.He was very unconvinced by this. Should forwards be discriminated against?
In fact, Arsenal currently does not have a high demand for forwards in either the youth team or the first team.
In England, football has become a part of people's lives. There are many excellent forwards, but relatively few defenders and midfielders.
Moreover, the Arsenal team currently has too many excellent forwards, so even though Wang Li's level is not bad, Mr. Steve Bird of the Arsenal youth team still gave up on him when selecting players at the football school.
However, Wang Li did not give up because of this. He wanted to go to other teams, use his own strength to prove the mistakes of the Arsenal youth team coach, and then transfer back to Arsenal like a hero.
So, Wang Li began his trial training journey. He went to Fulham, West United Ham, and Charlton respectively, but the results were not satisfactory. Although his strength was not bad, his Arsenal-like tone of voice was obviously not liked by these teams, so...
Wang Li, who had never encountered any setbacks since childhood, retreated a little. He was very sad and desperate. He didn't know why these teams gave up on him. He just felt that his football skills were very poor, which made those coaches look down on him. So he felt that his childhood aspirations were shattered and life was no longer important. He took a lot of sleeping pills...
...
Duan Song opened his eyes and saw a Western-style guest room. He blinked blankly and said with some surprise: "Is this modern society?"
He looked at it in confusion, and just about to stand up, his mind was hit by a torrent of information, and he suddenly felt pain, so he passed out again.
A day later, he woke up again.
He opened his eyes, stretched his eyebrows and smiled, and said to himself: "Is it called Wang Li... So this is really modern society, August 2003? This is the Holloway area of London? The owner of this body is really hard to imagine."
Wang Li's father, Wang Hai, is a young professor at the University of London, and his mother is an Englishman named Ellis Tina. Children who grow up in such a wealthy family do not have strong psychological endurance, so they choose to commit suicide after encountering a little setback.
This just makes Duan Song cheaper.
"Since I have taken over your body, will I help you realize your dream and become an excellent football player? However, I don't like the Arsenal team. Since they gave up on me, they should really regret it! Although I am not good at playing football, and this body does not have any internal strength, but after practicing martial arts in the coffin palace for so many years, it is still easy to play football after cultivating some internal strength." He thought with some happiness.
Then, from now on, we will practice football during the day and practice internal strength at night. This is a modern society and is not under the jurisdiction of King Yama. They should not be able to catch him.
He stood up from the sofa, stretched and touched his stomach.
He heard the sound of "gu, gu" coming from his stomach, and he cracked his mouth. It turned out that he had been unconscious for a long time, and it seemed that he needed to eat something.
He looked around carefully and found some canned noodles and instant noodles in the refrigerator, and ate them immediately.
He touched his bulging stomach, smiled with satisfaction, picked up a football with 'NIKE' printed on it beside the bed, and walked downstairs.
In "Wang Li's" memory, there was a small football field behind this building, where he often practiced alone.
